missing.why: The CLI commands send, retry, cancel and reschedule all call client.approvals.prepare (packages/sdk/src/accounts/approvals.ts:106). That method loads the Safe, prepares the payment command, opens an approval and abandons the execution on a mismatch, so it composes several calls. It lives in sdk/src/accounts, not sdk/src/payments, so the flows.ts writer's scope (client.payments.<name>) may not cover it. flows.ts did not exist when I checked. The book's pages name client.payments.pay for send and client.payments.retry for retry, but the CLI calls neither.

payment wait calls client.payments.subscribe (packages/sdk/src/payments/methods.ts:52, subscription.ts:43, fresh-query.ts:37). It holds a live subscription to payments.records.get and makes a fresh read of it on every change, so it does local work beyond forwarding one rpc. If flows.ts books it as forwarding only, point implementedBy at rpc_payments_records_get from ./movements.ts instead. flows.ts did not exist when I checked.
